sources.title: A Safer London for Everyone
sources.verified_claim: The Mayor's Police and Crime Plan 2025-29 sets London-wide priorities on violence, safer communities, MPS reform and victim support. Strategic priorities do not quantify exact parcel crime risk.

sources.title: London's Violence Reduction Unit
sources.verified_claim: The VRU reports prevention and early-intervention programmes and current performance indicators. City-wide intervention activity is not a safety guarantee or parcel-specific crime measurement.

sources.title: Community safety
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's community-safety service covers antisocial behaviour, domestic abuse, serious violence, CCTV, Prevent and emergency planning. Service scope is borough context rather than a risk score for parcel_30762.

sources.title: Violence Against Women and Girls Strategy launched
sources.verified_claim: Enfield reports Cabinet approval of its VAWG Strategy 2026-35 through the Safer Stronger Communities Board and police partnership. Borough strategy status does not establish parcel-specific personal-safety conditions.

sources.title: Havering Community Safety Partnership
sources.verified_claim: Havering identifies its statutory Community Safety Partnership and its police, fire and other partners. Partnership governance is not parcel_46142 crime-risk evidence.

sources.title: Havering Community Safety Partnership Plan 2026-29
sources.verified_claim: Havering Cabinet agreed the Community Safety Partnership Plan 2026-29 on 14 January 2026. An adopted borough plan guides priorities but does not provide an exact parcel safety measurement.

sources.title: Safer Lambeth Partnership Strategic Assessment
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's strategic assessment confirms priority crime and safety themes used for resource decisions. Borough assessment and historical reporting period are retained and are not treated as parcel_61522 exposure.

sources.title: Safer Lambeth Partnership
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth describes its statutory Community Safety Partnership duties on crime, serious violence, reoffending and substance misuse. Partnership duties are governance context, not a parcel-level safety score.
